description: This file defines a mock class `ServiceMock` for testing purposes, which implements the `WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell` interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for various functionalities of a service component within the `entservices-appgateway-34` project, specifically for unit testing.
